pages.text: $(thing)Shutdown$() is the safe way to stop. It turns the laser off, realigns the stabilizers, spins the disc down and returns to Offline. You keep all your mass.
$(danger)SCRAM$() snaps everything back at once.$(br2)Above $(num)3,600 rpm$() the sudden stop causes a $(l:safety/failures)disc stall$(). Use Shutdown whenever you can.
pages.title: SCRAM
